proposed_capability: Map stored Sim preferences from Live Mode through Simology to existing-household CAS. Correct evidenced mistakes or evaluate repeat, attributed changes in activity output.
player_save_control_impact: Player choices are protected from statistical correction; an explicit correction can restore a mistaken choice. GUI planning is lab-only under the separate screen owner and grants no permit; native writes require an independently validated game adapter.
expected_outcome: Listener evaluates a bounded stored-preference packet. Verified identity and control cues drive the next route step. Clear separation of attraction branch and activity scoring. Distinct readback required before confirmed completion.
negative_tests: Wrong branch or unknown CAS scene
Existing-household save ownership or effect unverified
Staged CAS transition must reobserve before proceeding
rollback_path: Revert source feature; no external state or save writes are performed by policy.
unresolved_unknowns: Exact-build Windows Simology to CAS and native write binding require game-host P08
Activity model thresholds need independent paired gameplay receipts
